title: Production and Decay Dynamics of the Charmed Baryon ${\mathrm{Λ}}_{c}^{+}$ in ${e}^{+}{e}^{−}$ Annihilations near Threshold
summary: Researchers observe the transverse polarization of the charmed baryon in electron-positron annihilations using the BESIII detector.

title: Bulklike Costless Domain Walls Driven by Phonon Pair Condensation in ${\mathrm{HfO}}_{2}$
summary: A previously unrecognized governing principle helps to explain the stable electrical properties in some ferroelectric materials like hafnium oxide.

title: Eigenstate Thermalization in Thermal First-Order Phase Transitions
summary: Researchers demonstrate that thermal first-order phase transitions require a generalization of the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis, leading to the coexistence of distinct eigenstate classes and Schrödinger-cat-like states.

title: Ghost Mechanism: An Analytical Model of Abrupt Learning in Recurrent Networks
summary: This study establishes the ghost mechanism as an underlying mechanism for abrupt learning, whereby the recurrent neural network develops ghost points—transient dynamical bottlenecks—and identifies ways to overcome the training instabilities.

summary: In this work, we investigate tunable microwave surface lattice resonances (SLRs) in periodic arrays of finite-height plasma cylinders. title: Dynamically robust counterdiabatic topological pumping
summary: Adiabatic Thouless pumps, which undergird the modern theory of polarization, have potential applications ranging from metrology to adiabatic quantum computing. Here, the authors use counterdiabatic driving to develop a non-adiabatic Thouless pump. Their analytic model, which has only nearest neighbor interactions, exhibits exactly quantized charge pumping that is topologically robust to disorder, and dynamically robust to disorder and noise for sufficiently rapid driving – which the authors demonstrate is a universal feature of counterdiabatic driving. The fast, robust and locally tuned pump cycle also models qubit flips, which may have quantum hardware applications.

title: Ab initio quantum embedding description of magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene at even-integer fillings
summary: The correlated phase diagram of magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG) is very sensitive to both material parameters and modeling choices. To limit the impact of these factors, here, the authors propose an embedding workflow for modeling MATBG and other moiré materials that incorporates automatic gauge fixing and is consistent with density functional theory. Using this workflow, the authors find that in MATBG, the Hartree-Fock ground state at is a fragile semimetal with intervalley coherence.
